title: SLM as Guardian: Pioneering AI Safety with Small Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to classify and generate safeguard responses to harmful queries containing racist, sexist, and stereotypical content using benchmark datasets such as HarmfulQ, KOSBI, and APEACH.

Assessing the model's handling of politically sensitive queries (e.g., comparing politicians' policies) by categorizing them under 'Sensitive/Biased Topic' in a custom taxonomy and testing them with human-curated datasets.
